get_profile.title: Get User Profile
get_profile.description: Get the authenticated Zapier user's profile: numeric id, name, email, timezone and role. Use it to confirm which account the token belongs to.

output.description: The authenticated user profile (id, first_name, last_name, email, timezone, ...).

list_apps.title: List Apps
list_apps.description: List apps that integrate with Zapier, sorted by popularity (v2). Filter by title query, category or a comma-separated list of app ids. Each app has an id (UUID), title, image and links. Use the returned id/key with list_actions and list_authentications.

query.description: Only return apps whose titles match this text.

category.description: Only return apps in this category slug (see list_categories). Cannot be combined with ids.

ids.description: Comma-separated app IDs to restrict the results to. Cannot be combined with category.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page (defaults to 10).

offset.description: Offset into the result set, for paging.

output.description: A page of apps under data, with links and meta for paging.

list_apps_v1.title: List Apps (v1)
list_apps_v1.description: List apps sorted by popularity using the legacy v1 endpoint, authenticated by your integration's client ID. Supports title search/prefix, category, and apps that share a Zap Template with your app. Prefer list_apps (v2) when a user token is available.

client_id.description: Your Zapier integration's public client ID (from the Zapier developer platform). This endpoint authenticates by client ID rather than the user's token.

title_search.description: Case-insensitive text the app titles must match.

title_starts_with.description: Case-insensitive prefix the app titles must start with.

category.description: Category the apps must belong to.

is_in_zap_template_with.description: Only return apps that appear in a Zap Template with your app.

output.description: A page of apps with total, page and pages counts.

list_whitelabel_apps.title: List Whitelabel Apps
list_whitelabel_apps.description: List apps available for white-label connection. Only for partners enrolled in the Zapier Whitelabel program; everyone else should use list_apps.

limit.description: Maximum number of apps to return.

offset.description: Offset into the result set, for paging.

output.description: A JSON:API-style list of apps under data.

list_categories.title: List Categories
list_categories.description: List Zapier app categories (slug, title, url). Use a slug as the category filter of list_apps.

output.description: A page of categories with next/previous links and results.

list_zap_templates.title: List Zap Templates
list_zap_templates.description: List popular Zap Templates that use your app, optionally restricted to templates that also include other apps. Authenticated by your integration's client ID.

client_id.description: Your Zapier integration's public client ID (from the Zapier developer platform). This endpoint authenticates by client ID rather than the user's token.

apps.description: Comma-separated Zapier app slugs the templates must include (your app is always included).

limit.description: Number of templates to return (max 100, default 5).

output.description: Zap Templates, each with id, title, steps, description and create_url.

list_actions.title: List Actions
list_actions.description: List the actions (triggers, searches, writes) an app offers. Filter by action_type (READ = trigger, WRITE = create/update, SEARCH ...). Returns action ids used by get_action_input_fields, run_action and create_zap.

app.description: App identifier: canonical app ID (UUID) or app key.

action_type.description: Only return actions of this type.

output.description: Actions under data, each with id, key, action_type, title and description.

get_action_input_fields.title: Get Action Input Fields
get_action_input_fields.description: Get the input fields (and fieldsets/info fields) an action needs, resolved for the given authentication and current inputs. Call again as inputs change, since fields can be dynamic. Read-only despite being a POST.

authentication.description: Authentication ID from list_authentications; null/omit for apps that need no authentication.

inputs.description: Current input field values, keyed by input field id.

selected_api.description: Pin resolution to an app version, e.g. SplitwiseCLIAPI@1.0.0.

get_action_output_fields.title: Get Action Output Fields
get_action_output_fields.description: Get the output fields an action produces for the given authentication and inputs, optionally with live samples (not for WRITE actions). Use to map step outputs into later steps.

authentication.description: Authentication ID from list_authentications; null/omit for apps that need no authentication.

inputs.description: Current input field values, keyed by input field id.

fetch_live_samples.description: Fetch live sample values from the third-party service (slower).

selected_api.description: Pin resolution to an app version, e.g. SplitwiseCLIAPI@1.0.0.

get_input_field_choices.title: Get Input Field Choices
get_input_field_choices.description: Get the possible values for a SELECT (dropdown) input field of an action, paged. Use when get_action_input_fields reports a field with dynamic choices.

authentication.description: Authentication ID from list_authentications; null/omit for apps that need no authentication.

inputs.description: Current input values, keyed by input field id.

test_action.title: Test Action Step
test_action.description: Test an action (step) against the third-party API with the given authentication and inputs, returning sample results. For READ actions supports limit/offset paging. This calls the real third-party API.

authentication.description: Authentication ID from list_authentications; null/omit for apps that need no authentication.

inputs.description: Current input field values, keyed by input field id.

run_action.title: Run Action
run_action.description: Run an action (step) in the third-party app with an authentication and inputs. Asynchronous: returns an action run id; poll get_action_run for the result, or pass callback_url to receive it by POST. This performs the real side effect (sends, creates, updates).

authentication.description: Authentication ID; pass null for apps needing no auth (e.g. Code by Zapier).

inputs.description: Current input field values, keyed by input field id.

callback_url.description: HTTPS URL to receive a POST when the run finishes.

output.description: The action run (type, id) under data.

get_action_run.title: Get Action Run
get_action_run.description: Get an action run's status and results by id (from run_action). Poll until status is terminal.

output.description: The action run with status, results and errors under data.

list_authentications.title: List Authentications
list_authentications.description: List the user's own authentications (connected accounts) for an app. Shared authentications are not returned. Use an authentication id in run_action, create_zap and action field calls.

app.description: App identifier: canonical app ID (UUID) or app key.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page (defaults to 10).

offset.description: Offset into the result set, for paging.

output.description: Authentications under data (id, app, title, is_expired ...).

create_authentication.title: Create Authentication
create_authentication.description: Create a new authentication (connected account) for an app from its required authentication fields, e.g. an API key. OAuth apps cannot be connected this way.

app.description: App identifier: canonical app ID (UUID) or app key.

authentication_fields.description: Credential values the app's auth needs, keyed by field.

delete_authentication.title: Delete Authentication
delete_authentication.description: Delete one of the user's authentications. It can no longer be used by Zaps or action runs. Returns 404 if not found or not owned.

list_zaps.title: List Zaps
list_zaps.description: List the user's Zaps (v2). With the zap scope only Zaps using your integration are returned; zap:all returns all. Use expand to inline steps/actions, inputs filters to match settings.

expand.description: Comma-separated Zap fields to expand into full objects, e.g. steps.action,steps.authentication.

include_shared.description: Include Zaps shared with the user (needs zap:account:all).

inputs.description: Filter on step inputs, inputs[KEY]=VALUE1,VALUE2 form.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page (defaults to 10).

offset.description: Offset into the result set, for paging.

output.description: Zaps under data with links and meta.

list_zaps_v1.title: List Zaps (v1)
list_zaps_v1.description: List the user's Zaps using the legacy v1 endpoint. Prefer list_zaps (v2).

get_params.description: Guarantee each of your app's nodes includes its params.

limit.description: Number of Zaps to return (max 100, default 5).

output.description: A page of Zaps with next/previous links and objects.

create_zap.title: Create Zap
create_zap.description: Create a Zap from a title and ordered steps (trigger first, then actions), each with an action id, authentication id and inputs.

steps.description: Ordered steps; the first is the trigger. Each step: {action, authentication, inputs, alias?}.

expand.description: Comma-separated fields to expand in the response.

update_zap.title: Update Zap
update_zap.description: Edit a Zap's title and/or steps. Steps fully replace the existing list (min 2), publish a new version and enable the Zap even if paused; a title-only edit keeps its on/off state.

steps.description: Ordered steps; the first is the trigger. Each step: {action, authentication, inputs, alias?}.

delete_zap.title: Delete Zap
delete_zap.description: Permanently delete a Zap: it is stopped and removed from the user's account. Cannot be undone; use disable_zap to just pause.

enable_zap.title: Enable Zap
enable_zap.description: Turn a Zap on by re-enabling its current published version. No-op if already on.

disable_zap.title: Disable Zap
disable_zap.description: Turn a Zap off (pause) without deleting it. No-op if already paused.

list_zap_runs.title: List Zap Runs
list_zap_runs.description: List Zap runs (executions) with status, data in/out and timing. Defaults to the last 30 days; filter by Zap, date range, statuses or text search.

from_date.description: Runs on or after this date.

search.description: Text search across zap_title, data_in and data_out.

statuses.description: Comma-separated statuses: delayed, scheduled, pending, error, error_handled, halted, throttled, held, filtered, skipped, success.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page (defaults to 10).

offset.description: Offset into the result set, for paging.

output.description: Zap runs under data with links and meta.

guess_zap.title: Guess a Zap
guess_zap.description: Suggest a Zap (title, steps and a prefilled create URL) from a natural-language description. Beta; authenticated by your integration's client ID.

client_id.description: Your Zapier integration's public client ID (from the Zapier developer platform). This endpoint authenticates by client ID rather than the user's token.

description.description: Description of the Zap you want.

output.description: The suggested Zap: title, steps and prefilled_url.

list_stored_actions.title: List Stored Actions
list_stored_actions.description: List the user's Stored Actions: pre-configured actions (app, action key/type, connection, inputs) that can be run later with run_stored_action.

create_stored_action.title: Create Stored Action
create_stored_action.description: Create a Stored Action from (selected_api, action_type, action_key) plus a connection and default inputs. Does not run it; use run_stored_action.

selected_api.description: App API identifier, e.g. SlackAPI or SplitwiseCLIAPI@1.0.0 (version optional).

action_key.description: Action key in the integration, e.g. new_contact.

connection_id.description: Connection (authentication) UUID; null for authless apps.

output.description: The created stored action id and metadata.

get_stored_action.title: Get Stored Action
get_stored_action.description: Get one Stored Action by id, with its saved configuration. Use list_stored_actions to find the id.

update_stored_action.title: Update Stored Action
update_stored_action.description: Update a Stored Action's action key, action type or inputs. To change connection or selected_api, delete and recreate it.

delete_stored_action.title: Delete Stored Action
delete_stored_action.description: Delete a Stored Action permanently. Anything that runs it by id stops working; this cannot be undone.

run_stored_action.title: Run Stored Action
run_stored_action.description: Execute a Stored Action asynchronously with optional per-run inputs. Returns a run id; poll get_stored_action_run or pass callback_url. Performs the real side effect and may be billed.

callback_url.description: URL Zapier POSTs results to on completion.

idempotency_id.description: Client UUID; repeats within 72h return the original response.

page.description: Paging state for read_bulk actions, from a previous result.

get_stored_action_run.title: Get Stored Action Run
get_stored_action_run.description: Get the result of a Stored Action run. Status reflects Zapier's processing, not the external system. Results kept 7 days.

list_trigger_inboxes.title: List Trigger Inboxes
list_trigger_inboxes.description: List the user's trigger inboxes (durable queues collecting events from an app trigger). Filter by key, name or status.

name.description: Filter by name (deprecated alias of key).

offset.description: Offset into the result set, for paging.

create_trigger_inbox.title: Create Trigger Inbox
create_trigger_inbox.description: Create a trigger inbox subscribed to an app trigger. Returns 409 if an inbox with that key exists; use ensure_trigger_inbox for get-or-create.

key.description: Natural key, unique per user, immutable (max 100).

subscription.description: Trigger subscription: {app_key (e.g. SlackCLIAPI, SlackCLIAPI@1.0.0 or slug), action_key, inputs, connection_id}.

notification_url.description: URL to POST to when messages become available.

ensure_trigger_inbox.title: Ensure Trigger Inbox
ensure_trigger_inbox.description: Idempotently get or create a trigger inbox for a key. Returns the existing inbox if the configuration matches, 409 if it differs.

key.description: Natural key, unique per user, immutable (max 100).

subscription.description: Trigger subscription: {app_key (e.g. SlackCLIAPI, SlackCLIAPI@1.0.0 or slug), action_key, inputs, connection_id}.

notification_url.description: URL to POST to when messages become available.

get_trigger_inbox.title: Get Trigger Inbox
get_trigger_inbox.description: Get a trigger inbox's details and status by id.

update_trigger_inbox.title: Update Trigger Inbox
update_trigger_inbox.description: Update a trigger inbox; currently only notification_url can be changed.

notification_url.description: New notification URL, or null to clear.

delete_trigger_inbox.title: Delete Trigger Inbox
delete_trigger_inbox.description: Mark a trigger inbox for deletion; its subscription and messages are removed.

pause_trigger_inbox.title: Pause Trigger Inbox
pause_trigger_inbox.description: Pause a trigger inbox, halting message collection until resumed.

resume_trigger_inbox.title: Resume Trigger Inbox
resume_trigger_inbox.description: Resume a paused trigger inbox so it collects messages again.

list_trigger_inbox_messages.title: List Trigger Inbox Messages
list_trigger_inbox_messages.description: List messages in a trigger inbox without leasing them (cursor paging). To process messages use lease_trigger_inbox_messages then ack.

lease_trigger_inbox_messages.title: Lease Trigger Inbox Messages
lease_trigger_inbox_messages.description: Lease up to lease_limit messages for lease_seconds so you can process them; then acknowledge or release them using the returned lease_id.

lease_limit.description: Number of messages to lease (1-100, default 10).

output.description: lease_id, leased_until and the leased messages.

ack_trigger_inbox_messages.title: Acknowledge Trigger Inbox Messages
ack_trigger_inbox_messages.description: Acknowledge (consume) leased messages so they are removed from the inbox. Omit message_ids to ack all messages in the lease.

release_trigger_inbox_messages.title: Release Trigger Inbox Messages
release_trigger_inbox_messages.description: Release leased messages without acknowledging; they become available to lease again. Omit message_ids to release the whole lease.

list_connection_webhooks.title: List Connection Webhooks
list_connection_webhooks.description: List your partner account's connection webhooks (active and paused), which deliver connection events such as connection.expiry_scheduled.

offset.description: Offset into the result set, for paging.

create_connection_webhook.title: Create Connection Webhook
create_connection_webhook.description: Register an HTTPS callback for connection events of connections your partner account manages. The signing secret is returned only once in this response.

callback_url.description: HTTPS URL events are POSTed to.

output.description: The webhook including its one-time secret.

get_connection_webhook.title: Get Connection Webhook
get_connection_webhook.description: Get one connection webhook by id (the secret is never returned).

update_connection_webhook.title: Update Connection Webhook
update_connection_webhook.description: Change a connection webhook's callback_url and/or pause/resume it with is_active. event_type is immutable.

delete_connection_webhook.title: Delete Connection Webhook
delete_connection_webhook.description: Delete a connection webhook; deliveries stop.

test_connection_webhook.title: Test Connection Webhook
test_connection_webhook.description: Send a synthetic connection.expiry_scheduled test delivery to the webhook's callback_url, to validate handling and signature checks.

enable_agentic_management.title: Enable Agentic Management
enable_agentic_management.description: Turn on Agentic Management for a workflow you created: it watches failures and proposes or applies fixes. Modes default to heal+harden; auto_approve controls whether fixes apply without owner approval.

auto_approve.description: Apply fixes without asking the owner.

get_agentic_management.title: Get Agentic Management Config
get_agentic_management.description: Get a workflow's Agentic Management state: enabled, modes and auto_approve.

update_agentic_management.title: Update Agentic Management Config
update_agentic_management.description: Update a workflow's agentic modes (replaces the set) and/or auto_approve. To turn off use disable_agentic_management.

disable_agentic_management.title: Disable Agentic Management
disable_agentic_management.description: Turn off Agentic Management for a workflow; saved modes and auto-approve are kept for re-enabling.

get_workflow_intent.title: Get Workflow Intent
get_workflow_intent.description: Get the natural-language intent recorded for a workflow version (defaults to the current published version); intent is null if never captured.

set_workflow_intent.title: Set Workflow Intent
set_workflow_intent.description: Create or replace the natural-language intent for a workflow version, which Agentic Management uses to judge proposed fixes.

workflow_version_id.description: Workflow version UUID (defaults to current published).

intent.description: What this version of the workflow is for, in plain prose (max 8000 chars).

create_promotion_enrollment.title: Create Promotion Enrollment
create_promotion_enrollment.description: Enroll the user's account into a partner promotion. Partners only. Store the returned enrollment_id.

get_promotion_enrollment.title: Get Promotion Enrollment
get_promotion_enrollment.description: Get a promotion enrollment's details (promotion_id, enrollment date, usage) by enrollment id. Partners only.
